workload_fingerprint.zk_mode: Ligero HVZK masking: t_pad uniform coefficients (Z_H s_j) per row, 6D committed mask rows (prox/lin/quad x2/chain x2: q masked by a uniform zero-sum polynomial, AHIV22 u_add -- red team F1 fixed), evaluation on the coset g<w_n> disjoint from H (PROTOCOL.md 8b); malicious-verifier: HM96/GK step-0 commitment c_i = H(r_i || s_i) to both verifier coins before root, opened after root / after the test messages, prover aborts on a mismatched opening; challenges are functions of the coins alone (F2 fixed), simulator by rewinding with a CRH only (PROTOCOL.md 8c; redteam/simulator.py against the real verify()); NOTE: this statement publishes the operands a, b and the words y16 (statement_digest), so privacy is vacuous for it today -- the ZK claim is about the construction (masking + coins) and becomes meaningful once operands are committed (auth-integration LEAF_V2)

workload_fingerprint.note: 4096 VUs as 25 independently committed proofs of <= 170 VUs each (l = 16384 columns, 64 pad columns per proof); prover time = sum over the proofs; soundness = union bound
